rules.statement: A promise to pay a prescribed debt, even if not in writing as required by the Ordinance, can take the case out of the operation of prescription laws and allow an action to be maintained.
rules.supporting_quote: "When the time has expired within which an action to recover a debt is maintainable, and the debtor afterwards promises in writing to pay the debt or makes a payment on account of it, the effect of the promise in writing, or of the payment (from which a promise to pay the balance is inferred), is not to revive a dead claim, but to take the case out of the operation of the enactments which prescribe the time within which an action must be brought."
